Sadness.definition: Whether the person is feeling sad, down, or unhappy (or feeling happy/content).

Pessimism.definition: Whether the person has negative or positive expectations about the future; hopelessness or hopefulness.

Sense_of_failure.definition: Whether the person has feelings of having failed or succeeded; disappointment or pride in oneself.

Loss_of_Pleasure.definition: Whether the person is experiencing pleasure, enjoyment, or interest in activities (or lack thereof).

Guilty_feelings.definition: Whether the person experiences guilt, self-blame, or feelings of innocence/self-forgiveness.

Sense_of_punishment.definition: Whether the person feels punished, deserving of punishment, or feeling safe/undeserving of punishment.

Self-dislike.definition: Whether the person feels disappointment/dislike or acceptance/appreciation of oneself.

Self-incrimination.definition: Whether the person engages in harsh self-criticism or self-compassion; blaming oneself or others for problems.

Suicidal_ideas.definition: Whether the person has thoughts about death, suicide, or life-affirming thoughts and desires to live.

Crying.definition: Whether the person experiences crying, increased tendency to cry, or emotional stability.

Agitation.definition: Whether the person feels restlessness, irritability, or calmness and ability to relax.

Social_withdrawal.definition: Whether the person is withdrawing from or engaging with people and activities.

Indecision.definition: Whether the person experiences difficulty or ease in making decisions.

Feelings_of_worthlessness.definition: Whether the person feels worthless or valuable; having little or significant self-worth.

Loss_of_energy.definition: Whether the person experiences fatigue, reduced energy, or feeling energized and capable.

Change_of_sleep.definition: Whether the person is sleeping more, less, or normally compared to usual.

Irritability.definition: Whether the person experiences increased annoyance, anger, or patience and calmness.

Changes_in_appetite.definition: Whether the person is eating more, less, or normally compared to usual.

Concentration_difficulty.definition: Whether the person has trouble or ease with focusing, reading, or making decisions.

Tiredness_or_fatigue.definition: Whether the person feels tired easily, all the time, or energetic and alert.

Loss_of_interest_in_sex.definition: Whether the person has decreased, normal, or increased sexual interest or drive.
